web_deployment.method: Applied the Queries menu and HTTP prompt example changes to the N3 web assets. Reloaded the proxy with the existing N3 runtime and prompt-capable demonstrator.

queries_menu.result: Loaded the count-server example and opened the Queries menu with its saved queries.

http_prompt_example.result: Each of two replies carried its current prompt reference. The example echoed the test term and completed successfully after stop.

peer_credential_rotation.method: Reloaded N3's peer authorization rule and restarted the N7 adapter to load the replacement credential.
peer_credential_rotation.authorization_probe: Checked access to the peer-only WebSocket I/O command.

live_actor_round_trip.observation: An N7 actor spawned a peer on N3. The nested call returned to N7, the terminal received the expected output, and the query succeeded.
